about_the_game:
As One We Survive is a top-down survival game set in a post-apocalyptic America. Step into the shoes of a father as he tries to find help for his sick daughter during a grid down post-pandemic event. Fight, scavenge, craft, and gather resources for your family's survival.

Using a unique blend of survival and colony management mechanics, you will have to form a community both to survive and find help for your daughter. Build and manage your community, protect your people from danger, and make tough decisions that will determine the fate of your group in a harsh and unforgiving world.



  • Challenging Survival: Scavenge, craft, and outsmart the harsh wilderness in a dangerous world with scarce resources.
  • Unforgiving Combat: No health packs; use bandages to stop bleeding, sleep to heal injuries, and maintain weapons for reliability.
  • Community Management: Join a survivor community, upgrade your base with facilities, and create renewable resources to support your people.
  • NPC Companions: Form bonds with fellow survivors while scavenging for vital supplies and getting to know your community.
  • Skill Progression: Hone survival skills in the wilderness, improve with every challenge, and master the art of survival.
  • Two Modes Of Play: Story and Survival. Experience a narrative in Story mode, then test your skills in the post-apocalyptic world alone or with a companion.






  • Form a Community: Recruit survivors to create a safe haven.
  • Supply Runs: Gather food, water, and medicine for survival.
  • Building and Resources: Construct facilities, create renewable resources.
  • Uncover Missions: Get intel from recruits, advance the story to help your daughter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 / AMD R9 280X
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 / AMD Ryzen 7 1700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD RX Vega 56
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic world. Form a community, scavenge resources, build facilities, and defend yourself against a lawless world while joining a father's desperate journey to save his sick daughter.
